votes.motion: B BLUFFDALE BLUFFDALE CITY PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA Wednesday,December 7,2022 Notice is hereby given that the Bluffdale City Planning Commission will hold a public meeting on Wednesday. December 7.2022.at 6:00 p.m.. or as soon thereafter as possible at the Bluffdale City Hall, 2222 West 14400 South, Bluffdale, Utah. This meeting may also be broadcast live to the public on the City's website www.bluffdale.com. Notice is further given that access to this meeting by Commission members may be by electronic means via telephone conference call. PUNNING COMMISSION BUSINESS MEETING 6:00 PM 1
votes.result: The motion passed unanimously with one abstention
